text_block_list.text:
While coaching <chrname>,
I accidentally twisted my leg
and ended up at the hospital, but——

text_block_list.name: Orthopedic Doctor
text_block_list.text:
This is a mild sprain.
You should avoid unnecessary movement for two or three days,
and have your trainee do independent practice for now.
——Um, are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for suddenly interrupting. You looked a bit down,
so... if you'd like,
would you care to walk back together while we chat?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see——you feel anxious because of the period
where you can't train them. That's true... as a Trainer,
that must be a really painful situation.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I could move around just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ——You mustn't, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right now, let your body rest properly... and during that time,
keep your spirit moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If you do, your body is sure to
catch up to your feelings!

I recall hearing that Sakura Laurel had weak legs since childhood
and had fallen behind her peers, but clawed her way up
through sheer hard work.
choice_data_list: Hearing you say it really makes it convincing.
Hearing that from you makes it truly convincing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I learned it firsthand.
The anxiety of falling behind, the frustration of enduring it,
and... the fact that with hard work, you can always rise back up.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even when I felt like coming to a halt...
song gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A song of happiness that we used to sing in our club.
Maybe it will give you some energy too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: 『——The cherry blossoms will surely bloom in our future~♪』
choice_data_list: (What a voice... it resonates straight into my heart...)

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, my! I thought I recognized that song,
and it really was you, Laurel-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Baku-chan, Chiyo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that song takes me right back to our club days!
Singing together, running all around together...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Whenever I hum this tune,
I can dash forward with even more bakushin than usual!
It is truly a magnificent bakushin song!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
『March on to victory~ Full of cheerful blooming energy~♪
Aim for victory~ With an indomitable spirit~♪』
choice_data_list: ...I really do feel like I've received energy from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that.
...Back when I had no choice but to watch over everyone,
those two would always come over and sing by my side——

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I truly love singing together with my clubmates.
Both back then, and now, always.
choice_data_list: That sounds like a wonderful club.
It makes me want to see your Winning Live, Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I truly love singing together with my clubmates.
Both back then, and now, always.
choice_data_list: That sounds like a wonderful club.
It makes me want to see your Winning Live, Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really is.
Every day was so lively, and we got along so well——

text_block_list.name: Club Members
text_block_list.text:
On your mark!
Get set, go!

text_block_list.name: Young Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Laurel-san!
I came up with a new motto,
won't you listen to it?!

text_block_list.name: Young Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I, too, have come up with a bakushin-style——no!
A super ultra bakushin-level famous quote!
Behold!!

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm curious about both~.
Tell me, tell me♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
——Because Baku-chan, Chiyo-chan, and the others
cheerfully stayed by my side, I barely had time to feel down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's the other way around! Seeing you move forward
without ever giving up no matter what,
Laurel-san, always gave me courage...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Dashing forward with positivity and fulfilling your wish brilliantly——
Laurel-san, you are the pride of the 'Victory Club'!
I hold my head exceptionally high with pride as well!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to run like everyone else as soon as possible.
Being able to run alongside them like this now
makes me so incredibly happy.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad that worked out.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So Trainer-san, as long as
you keep moving forward without losing heart,
the results are bound to follow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The cherry blossoms of you and your trainee will surely bloom.

Nodding at Sakura Laurel's words,
I headed on my way back with a positive mindset.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll win lots of races
and show you plenty of wonderful
Winning Lives♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I can't wait!
We'll definitely rush over to cheer for your races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We will inject Laurel-san with energy
using the 'Victory Club' fight song!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
『Overcome all hardships~ Seize the glory~
That's right, we are Victrooo-y~♪』

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's a deeply memorable, precious song.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! If you'd like, Trainer-san,
would you like to sing along with us?
It'll cheer you up even more, you know?
choice_data_list: Well, don't mind if I do.

text_block_list.text:
Humming the song together with Sakura Laurel and the others,
I returned to the academy with a bright, refreshed feeling.
